chapter: Rabbit Foot show and show life
title: Later career: Clyde Beatty Circus, Paul Barbarin and Pap Celestine
summary: Back in New Orleans he later spent seven months leading his own band with Clyde Beatty's circus and played with Paul Barbarin and Pap Celestine.
